_doc: docs/automation-foundations.md. pr_head = check-run names that ALWAYS exist at a PR head to main (a skipped conclusion is fine); every merge path refuses unless each is present at the pinned head and success/skipped/neutral. conditional = a job behind a workflow-level path filter: checked only when present (present and not OK = refuse), never demanded. post_merge_audits = WORKFLOW names that run on push to main only (never a check-run at a PR head): existence-checked by scripts/check-required-jobs.mjs, never re-read at head. Guard path: changing this file is an owner-merged guard change.

conditional.name: phone-qa
conditional.when: Phone QA (phone-qa.yml) runs only when the PR touches its paths: filter (UI paths, package.json/lockfile, vite/react-router config, its own files)

conditional.name: build-smoke
conditional.when: Phone QA (phone-qa.yml) job build-smoke: same paths: filter as phone-qa

conditional.name: types-drift
conditional.when: Supabase types drift (types-drift.yml) runs on a PR only when src/integrations/supabase/types.ts changes
